lessons.title: lesson-001: Hero must fit the first viewport with a single clear CTA
lessons.pattern: Broadcast value immediately; body copy optional on mobile.
lessons.worked: Hero crammed value, product name, one obvious CTA into the first fold. Motion stayed quiet and the interaction demo carried the visual weight.
lessons.failed: Earlier drafts with two competing CTAs and long hero copy lost clarity.

lessons.title: lesson-002: Mock interactions convert static previews into demos
lessons.pattern: A fake playground that responds to input is worth more than any description.
lessons.worked: A fake playground that responds to input (prompt -> plan -> diff -> apply)   made the preview feel like a real product.
lessons.failed: Static screenshot-only demos read as templates, not products.

lessons.title: lesson-003: Never copy the reference brand identity
lessons.pattern: Always use a fictional brand so the recreation can be published safely.
lessons.worked: Every published recreation used a fictional brand (Codeflare, Ledger, Relay,   Lumina) so the demo could be pushed publicly with zero legal ambiguity.
lessons.failed: Drafts that leaned on reference logos and taglines had to be replaced.

lessons.title: lesson-004: Over-animated chunks hurt perceived quality
lessons.pattern: Prefer quiet motion; one intentional interaction beats five decorative ones.
lessons.worked: A single hero entrance animation set the tone without stealing attention.
lessons.failed: Five decorative animations (bouncing cards, spinning badges, scroll-triggered   fades) made the page feel busy and cheap.

lessons.title: lesson-005: Mobile overflow is the most common silent defect
lessons.pattern: Always check horizontal overflow at 390px before declaring done.
lessons.worked: Adding 390px mobile checks to the pipeline caught overflows before shipping.
lessons.failed: Desktop-perfect pages shipped with horizontal scroll on mobile twice in a row.

lessons.title: lesson-006: Command center state stays in sync
lessons.pattern: Rewrite state from repo facts, never hand-edit it.
lessons.worked: P6 Command Center verified end to end: state sync + dashboard render.

lessons.title: lesson-007: Replicate Linear Landing
lessons.pattern: Small mission lifecycle, visible state, browser verification before completion.
